response: Yes, mitochondria play a critical and early role in developmentally regulated programmed cell death (PCD) in the lace plant. Research has shown that mitochondrial dynamics are correlated with other organelles during PCD, and that mitochondria move on transvacuolar strands to form a ring structure surrounding the nucleus. This suggests that mitochondria are involved in the remodelling of lace plant leaves during programmed cell death.
